Subject: Unexpected AWS Marketplace charge + VAT on April invoice (INV-8472)

Hi Irene,

We've run into a billing problem on our April AWS Marketplace statement (INV-8472). After our recent entity migration from Acme EU Ltd. to Acme Analytics Group (global consolidation), several Marketplace metering records appear to have been charged to the old entity and then recharged to the new entity in the same billing period. Net result: Acme was invoiced twice for roughly $18,450 (EUR 17,100) of usage and the VAT line shows a domestic VAT of 20% applied, but our EU reverse-charge should have been used.

Attachments: Invoice_8472_AWS-202704.pdf, metering_report_acme_week17.csv (extract)

Can Redwood confirm whether you see duplicate meter records on your side and if you can request credits from AWS/partner to correct the double charge? Also we need a VAT-corrected invoice showing reverse-charge (no VAT) for April so we can reclaim the incorrect VAT posting from our books.

Time is sensitive — our month-end closes next week. Any quick path to correction would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Lena Biro

Hi Marcus — thanks for the ticket and the extract. We confirmed there were duplicate meter reports submitted for the same product SKU across two entity IDs because the seller's listing was briefly mapped to both buyer entities during the migration window. Our ops team can do a one-time adjustment (credit) for the duplicate consumption and reissue the invoice, but we require:

1) Signed confirmation from the buyer (Acme) verifying the correct billing entity (ACME-GRP-1219) and acceptance of the credit amount.
2) Copy of buyer's VAT registration / EORI to support reverse-charge (you attached VAT_evidence_acme.zip but we need a clear scan of EU VAT certificate page + matching company registration).
3) The original marketplace order IDs (we see partials in the CSV — please provide the full order IDs for each duplicated line).

ETA: once we have those items, we estimate 5 business days to issue credit and re-issue the corrected invoice with VAT reversed.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Billing Support
marketplace-billing@amazonaws.com

Lena — quick update and next steps to close this before your close:

What we confirmed:
- Marcus validated the metering extract and identified 12 duplicated meter lines totaling USD 18,450 (EUR ~17,100).
- AWS confirmed they will process a one-time adjustment but need 3 items from you to proceed (see below).

Requested items (we consolidated them for speed):
1) A short approval email from Acme Finance confirming the correct billing entity is ACME-GRP-1219 and approving the credit amount of USD 18,450. (A single one-line approval will suffice).
2) A clear scan of the EU VAT certificate page plus company registration extract (we have VAT_evidence_acme.zip but AWS needs a single-page certificate scan).
3) Full marketplace order IDs for the duplicated lines — we've attached the CSV with highlighted rows; please fill the 'order_id' column and return. (Attachment: metering_report_acme_week17.csv)

If you can send those today/tomorrow, Marcus will push the packet to AWS as priority and Jonas will monitor the escalation. We'll confirm once the credit posts and share the corrected invoice for your VAT reclaim.

Thanks — apologies for the hassle; we'll keep you updated hourly once AWS begins processing.
